# Simon Willison's Weblog

> > Personal blog of Simon Willison covering AI security, LLMs, prompt injection, Datasette, SQLite, and practical experiments with emerging technologies.

Simon Willison is a software developer and co-creator of Django and Datasette. This blog features in-depth technical analysis, security research on AI systems, hands-on experiments with language models, and development notes on open-source data tools.

## Key Topics

- Prompt injection attacks and defenses
- Datasette and SQLite workflows
- OpenAI and LLM APIs
- AI security and safety
- Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
- GitHub Actions and automation
- Datasette Cloud deployment
- Docker containers
- LLM jailbreaking techniques
- Image generation (Midjourney)
- Meta Llama models
- Google Gemini
- Python tooling
- Data journalism and scraping

## AI Security and Prompt Injection

- [The Dual LLM pattern for building AI assistants that can resist prompt injection](https://simonwillison.net/2023/Apr/25/dual-llm-pattern): Security pattern using dual LLMs to prevent prompt injection attacks
- [Prompt injection and jailbreaking are not the same thing](https://simonwillison.net/2024/Mar/5/prompt-injection-jailbreaking): Clarifying differences between prompt injection and jailbreaking attacks
- [Accidental prompt injection against RAG applications](https://simonwillison.net/2024/Jun/6/accidental-prompt-injection): How semantic search can trigger unintentional prompt injection in RAG
- [New prompt injection papers: Agents Rule of Two and The Attacker Moves Second](https://simonwillison.net/2025/Nov/2/new-prompt-injection-papers): Review of Meta AI research on LLM agent security frameworks
- [The AI trust crisis](https://simonwillison.net/2023/Dec/14/ai-trust-crisis): Analysis of data privacy concerns with Dropbox and OpenAI AI features

## LLM Experiments and Reviews

- [AI assisted search-based research actually works now](https://simonwillison.net/2025/Apr/21/ai-assisted-search): Review of Perplexity, GPT-4, and Gemini deep research capabilities
- [Initial impressions of Llama 4](https://simonwillison.net/2025/Apr/5/llama-4-notes): First look at Meta's Llama 4 Maverick multimodal model capabilities
- [Experimenting with audio input and output for the OpenAI Chat Completion API](https://simonwillison.net/2024/Oct/18/openai-audio): Testing OpenAI's gpt-4o-audio-preview API with audio I/O capabilities
- [The evolution of OpenAI's mission statement](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Feb/13/openai-mission-statement): Tracking changes in OpenAI's mission via IRS tax filings analysis
- [Midjourney 5.1](https://simonwillison.net/2023/May/4/midjourney-51): Comparison of Midjourney v5.1 image generation with earlier versions

## Datasette and SQLite Tools

- [Datasette—an ecosystem of tools for working with small data](https://simonwillison.net/2021/Jul/22/small-data): PyGotham 2020 talk on Datasette and SQLite for personal data analytics
- [Datasette 0.63: The annotated release notes](https://simonwillison.net/2022/Oct/27/datasette-0-63): Detailed release notes for Datasette 0.63 with Python 3.11 support
- [Litestream backups for Datasette Cloud (and weeknotes)](https://simonwillison.net/2022/Aug/11/litestream-backups): Implementing Litestream SQLite backups for Datasette Cloud on Fly.io
- [Google Drive to SQLite](https://simonwillison.net/2022/Feb/20/google-drive-to-sqlite): CLI tool to export Google Drive metadata to SQLite for Datasette analysis
- [Tracking Mastodon user numbers over time with a bucket of tricks](https://simonwillison.net/2022/Nov/20/tracking-mastodon): Git scraping technique to track Mastodon user growth with GitHub Actions

## Development Weeknotes

- [Weeknotes: datasette-test, datasette-build, PSF board retreat](https://simonwillison.net/2024/Jan/21/weeknotes): Weekly updates on Datasette plugin testing and PSF board activities
- [Weeknotes: Apache proxies in Docker containers, refactoring Datasette](https://simonwillison.net/2021/Nov/22/apache-proxies-datasette): Weekly notes on Apache proxy configuration and Datasette refactoring
- [Weeknotes: Datasette internals](https://simonwillison.net/2020/Dec/27/weeknotes-datasette-internals): Weekly updates on SQLite schema versioning and Datasette permissions
